title: Injectivity of the integral generic ideal map
statement: For an integral Noetherian scheme Z, coherent module G, coherent ideal I, and a coherent finite coproduct of copies of I, every morphism χ from that coproduct to G whose generic stalk map is an isomorphism is a monomorphism.

proof.text: Let T be the generic module-stalk functor. Since T.map chi is an isomorphism, it is mono. Applying T to kernel.condition and cancelling T.map chi gives T.map (kernel.ι chi) = 0. Only functoriality and preservation of zero maps are needed; neither stalk exactness nor coherence of the kernel is used.

Prove the private helper ideal_map_eq_zero_of_generic_stalk: for any module F and f : F → I.toModules with zero generic stalk map, compose f with the ideal inclusion into O_Z. Naturality sends the germ of every image section to zero. Every nonempty open contains the generic point. Equality of germs gives a smaller nonempty open on which the structure-sheaf section vanishes. Mathlib map_injective_of_isIntegral makes restriction to that open injective, so the original image section is zero. TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext also handles the empty open. Sectionwise vanishing gives a zero map into O_Z, and cancellation of the monic ideal inclusion gives f = 0. This is a direct coordinatewise argument, without taking a quasi-coherent image ideal.

Identify the finite coproduct with its biproduct using HasBiproduct.of_hasCoproduct and biproduct.isoCoproduct. Each coordinate of kernel.ι chi has zero generic stalk map by the first step, hence is zero by the private helper. Biproduct projection extensionality makes kernel.ι chi zero; cancel the coproduct-biproduct isomorphism. Mathlib Abelian.mono_of_kernel_ι_eq_zero now proves Mono chi. Fin r is finite even for r = 0, where projection extensionality is vacuous.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01YE, coordinatewise generic-stalk injectivity argument; shortened by T1 using Mathlib integral restriction injectivity and finite biproduct extensionality

lean.statement:
theorem mono_of_coherent_ideal_sum_generic_iso (Z : Scheme.{w}) [IsNoetherian Z]
    [IsIntegral Z] (G : Z.Modules) (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace G)
    (r : ℕ) (I : Z.IdealSheafData)
    (χ : (∐ fun _ : Fin r => I.toModules) ⟶ G)
    (hI : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace I.toModules)
    (hSum : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace (∐ fun _ : Fin r => I.toModules))
    (hχ : IsIso ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Z.toRingedSpace (genericPoint Z)).map χ)) :
    Mono χ
